articles.title: TurboMamba: Faster Inference, Faster Training, and Better Prediction with Lexical Memory
articles.description: arXiv:2610.20682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce TurboMamba, a language-model architecture for faster inference, faster training, and better token prediction. A global Mamba-3 model runs once per completed token block. A small Transformer uses this global context and earlier tokens within the block to predict the next token. articles.description: arXiv:2610.20665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can solve complex interactive tasks, yet reasoning and tool calls take time. We introduce RealtimeBench, with 180 tasks across six game types, to evaluate agents while games continue running during inference.
